claim: Two churches light from the floor up, the roof the darkest surface: E3M4's funeral chapel (s286: floor 9 under a sloped ceiling at 45) and DWE1M4's cathedral (nave floor 36 under 43-46). DWE1M4 also lights toward the altar, its chancel floor (s288) at 24 against the nave's 36; E3M4 does not, its chancel s295 is at 16 under 55.
evidence: E3M4 s286: floor_shade 9, ceiling_shade 45; chancel s295 floor 16, ceiling 55 (python -m tools.catalog record E3M4 sector 286 / 295); DWE1M4 s288: floor_shade 24, ceiling 43; nave s276 floor 36, ceiling 46 (knowledge/blood/studies/church/notes.md:69,85)
two instances, one of them a community map: a precedent, not a count
